label: Coinmate
terms_note: Public operations only ('available without any user authentication'). Docs: an Apiary-hosted API Blueprint (the page is a JavaScript app; the forge reads Apiary's parsed blueprint). The docs: 'Please not make more than 100 request per minute or we will ban your IP address.' Every answer is HTTP 200 {error, errorMessage, data}; live 2026-10-01 an unknown pair answers {"error":true,"errorMessage":"Currency pair NOPE_EUR not found."}. No OHLC endpoint is documented.

get_ticker.note: symbol is a pair such as BTC_EUR or BTC_CZK; volume is the 24h amount in the base currency.

not_offered.me: Private operations are signed (HMAC-SHA256 over nonce + clientId + publicKey); public-data entry only.
not_offered.get_candles: No OHLC endpoint is documented (only transactions and the order book).
not_offered.get_balances: POST /balances is a signed private operation; public-data entry only.
not_offered.list_orders: POST /openOrders is a signed private operation; public-data entry only.
not_offered.place_order: POST /buyLimit and /sellLimit are signed and spend money; not mapped.

live_check.notes: all read tools answered, schema-valid, pagination advances
